result.title: Subprocess-Constrained Markov Decision Processes
result.comment: To appear at NeurIPS '26. Code available at https://github.com/jrgan/VSI
result.summary: Constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) typically bound expected cumulative cost from an initial state. Such a guarantee can be insufficient when a policy must remain feasible after every history it may encounter. We introduce \emph{subprocess-constrained MDPs} (S-CMDPs), which require the expected discounted cost of each continuation, conditional on any reachable history, to satisfy a bound determined by the current state. This stronger requirement changes the structure and complexity of the problem: we show that stationary policies can be strictly suboptimal, and finding even an approximately optimal stationary policy is NP-hard. We adapt a recently introduced value-set iteration framework to show that history-dependent policies surprisingly overcome both obstacles. Our polynomial-time algorithm represents such a policy implicitly: its expected reward is within $ε$ of the optimal feasible value, it violates each subprocess cost bound by at most $δ$, and its action distribution can be computed in polynomial time for any given history.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 subprocess-constrained MDPs，要求任意可达历史之后的延续期望折扣成本都满足由当前状态规定的界，证明平稳策略可严格次优、求解近似最优平稳策略为 NP-hard，并改造 value-set iteration，用隐式表示的历史依赖策略在多项式时间内获得近似可行且近最优的策略。
AI.relevance_reason: 「每条可达历史后仍须满足约束」的建模范式可能与 LVR 中 THINK/LOOK/STOP 逐步停止决策的安全性及历史依赖策略下的计算—收益权衡有关，可供核查其约束与隐式策略表示能否用于停止或证据获取决策。
